hero.subtitle: The AI & Young Professionals Summit & Innovation Challenge

about.summary: UNLOCK is an AI workplace innovation challenge and grand expo hosted at UiTM Shah Alam. Ten teams (five University Student teams and five Young Professional teams) join a 3-week online incubation sprint. The Top 2 teams from each category then set up booths and pitch their working prototypes at the UNLOCK Grand Finale on 6 December 2026 at Dewan Seroja, UiTM Shah Alam.
about.vision: To become a leading platform that bridges academia and industry in nurturing an innovative, AI-ready generation capable of shaping a sustainable, ethical and future-driven workforce.
about.mission: To empower students and young professionals with AI knowledge, innovative thinking, and practical problem-solving skills while fostering meaningful collaboration between academia and industry to promote ethical and responsible AI adoption in the workplace.
about.objective: To enhance knowledge and understanding of Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications in the workplace, encourage the development of innovative ideas and practical AI-driven solutions, and strengthen strategic collaboration among universities, industries, and communities towards ethical, responsible, and sustainable AI adoption.

faqs.a: Active university students (undergraduate and postgraduate) join the Student Category, and early-career working adults join the Young Professional Category.
faqs.alt: If you are a university student (undergraduate or postgraduate), register in the Student Category. If you are an early-career working adult, register as a Young Professional.

faqs.a: This is a pre-registration. Only the team leader registers, once, using the Student form or the Young Professional form in the Register section. You do not pay now: we email the payment details later. The leader and every member listed on the form then receive their own confirmation email with the Registration ID and the WhatsApp community link.
faqs.alt: Choose the Student or Young Professional pre-registration form in the Register section. The team leader fills it in once and pays later, when we email the payment details. Every member listed on the form receives a confirmation email automatically.

faqs.q: Should every team member fill in the registration form?
faqs.kw: duplicate members leader confirm confirmation member form
faqs.a: No. Only the team leader fills in the form, once, to avoid duplicate team records. Every member listed on it receives their own confirmation email automatically.
faqs.alt: No. One person per team (the leader) submits the form. Members do not need to fill in anything; they receive a confirmation email automatically.

faqs.kw: team size members pasukan how many spots
faqs.a: The cohort has 10 teams (50 talents): 5 Student teams and 5 Young Professional teams. Every team has exactly 5 members.
faqs.alt: There are 10 team places in total: 5 for students and 5 for young professionals. Each team must have exactly 5 people.

faqs.a: Customer Experience & Support, HR & Talent Operations, Operations & Productivity, Marketing & Content, Data & Decision-Making, and Sustainability & ESG. Each team picks one.
faqs.alt: Pick one of Customer Experience & Support, HR & Talent Operations, Operations & Productivity, Marketing & Content, Data & Decision-Making, or Sustainability & ESG.

faqs.kw: when date tarikh schedule timeline deadline
faqs.a: Pre-registration closes on Wednesday 11 November 2026. The online workshops are on Sunday 15, Saturday 21 and Saturday 28 November. Prototype slides are due on Tuesday 24 November, the finalist pack is due on Tuesday 1 December, and the Grand Finale is on Sunday 6 December 2026.
faqs.alt: Remember these dates: 11 Nov (pre-registration closes), 15, 21 and 28 Nov (online workshops), 24 Nov (prototype slides due), 1 Dec (finalist pack due) and 6 Dec 2026 (Grand Finale).

faqs.kw: venue location lokasi where uitm held happening place address dewan finale grand summit
faqs.a: The Grand Finale is at Dewan Seroja, UiTM Shah Alam. The 3-week workshop sprint is online on Google Meet.
faqs.alt: The 3-week sprint is online. The Grand Finale on 6 December is in person at Dewan Seroja, UiTM Shah Alam.

faqs.a: Week 1: kickoff, applied AI literacy and prototyping tools. Week 2: system architecture and wireframing. Week 3: prototype refinement and selection of the Top 2 teams in each category.
faqs.alt: Week 1 is the kickoff and AI literacy, Week 2 covers system architecture and wireframes, and Week 3 is prototype testing and the selection of the 4 finalists.

faqs.kw: judging criteria weightage marks scoring judged scored marked evaluated assessed score rubric
faqs.a: Judges look at Innovation and Originality, AI Integration & Technical Soundness, Problem Relevance & Track Alignment, Feasibility & Practical Functionality, Scalability & Organizational Impact, Pitch Presentation & Prototype Demo, and Future Potential & Roadmap.
faqs.alt: Teams are assessed on seven areas: originality, AI and technical soundness, problem relevance, feasibility, scalability and impact, the pitch and demo, and future potential.

faqs.kw: prize award trophy hamper medal hadiah top 2 top 4 goodies participant
faqs.a: 4 official trophies for the finalists (Top 2 Student and Top 2 Young Professional teams), a hamper for the People's Choice winner, goodies for the other 6 teams, and a medal for all 50 participants.
faqs.alt: The 4 finalist teams receive trophies, the People's Choice winner receives a hamper, the other 6 teams receive goodies, and every participant receives a medal.

faqs.q: What do we have to submit?
faqs.kw: deliverables submission requirements proposal prototype slides video deadline 24 november 1 december finalist finalists only
faqs.a: All teams: a 1-page proposal (Workshop 1), a technical brief and wireframes (Workshop 2), and prototype presentation slides by Tuesday 24 November 2026 (no working prototype needed yet). Finalists only: presentation slides and a demo video of the refined prototype by Tuesday 1 December 2026. At the Grand Finale, the 4 finalists bring a working prototype, a Zone B booth and the AI-Use Declaration, and give a 10-minute pitch.
faqs.alt: All teams submit a 1-page proposal, a technical brief and prototype slides (due Tue 24 Nov). Only the 4 finalists submit slides and a demo video by Tue 1 Dec, then bring their prototype, booth and AI-Use Declaration to the Grand Finale and pitch on stage.

faqs.a: An official form explaining which AI tools, models and APIs you used and how you prompted them. All third-party tools must be disclosed.
faqs.alt: It is an official form where you list every AI tool, model and API you used and describe how you prompted them.

faqs.q: Who pitches live at the finale?
faqs.kw: finalist pitch stage top 2 top 4 selection
faqs.a: The Top 2 Student teams and the Top 2 Young Professional teams (4 finalists) set up booths in Zone B and pitch live on the Main Stage (Zone A).
faqs.alt: Only the 4 finalists take part at the Grand Finale: the Top 2 Students and the Top 2 Young Professionals. They run booths in Zone B and pitch in Zone A.

faqs.a: An interactive visitor journey (Discover, Engage, Validate, Unlock) that takes delegates through all 4 finalist booths, with rewards to redeem.
faqs.alt: It is a visitor journey (Discover, Engage, Validate, Unlock) that guides delegates around the 4 finalist booths so they can redeem rewards.

faqs.q: How does the People's Choice Award work?
faqs.a: Summit delegates vote directly across the 4 finalist booths, and the winning team receives a hamper.
faqs.alt: Delegates at the summit vote at the 4 finalist booths, and the most-voted team wins the People's Choice Award and a hamper.

faqs.q: What is Zone A and Zone B?
faqs.a: Zone A is the Main Stage conference with talks, the final pitch and the awards. Zone B is the exhibition floor where the 4 finalist teams run interactive booths.
faqs.alt: Zone A is the main stage for talks, the final pitches and the awards. Zone B is the exhibition floor with the 4 finalist booths.

faqs.q: Can I join more than one team?
faqs.a: No. Each participant joins one team and one track only.
faqs.alt: No. You can only be in one team and one track.

faqs.q: Can we use private company data?
faqs.a: Not without clearance. Projects must follow the PDPA, with no unencrypted personal records, credentials or proprietary databases.
faqs.alt: Only with clearance. Projects must follow the PDPA and must not use unencrypted personal records, credentials or proprietary databases.

faqs.a: IP infringement, not disclosing core AI-generated code, fabricated results, late delivery outside approved windows, or unapproved absence from required sprint checkpoints.
faqs.alt: Copying others' IP, hiding core AI-generated code, made-up results, late delivery outside approved windows, or missing required checkpoints without approval.

faqs.q: Do we pay now or later?
faqs.kw: pay payment now later pre registration pre-registration fee bayar yuran rm65 rm180
faqs.a: The forms are for pre-registration only, so you pay later. After you pre-register, we email the payment details. The fee is RM65 per team for the Student category and RM180 per team for the Young Professional category.
faqs.alt: You pay later. Filling in the form is a pre-registration, and we send the payment details by email afterwards: RM65 per team for students and RM180 per team for young professionals.

faqs.a: Registration fees, if any, are non-refundable.
faqs.alt: Any registration fee that applies is non-refundable.

faqs.q: How do I join the WhatsApp group?
faqs.a: The link is in the confirmation email that every registered participant receives. It is only for registered participants, so it is not posted on this website.
faqs.alt: Participants receive the WhatsApp community link in their confirmation email, and official updates are also sent by email.

faqs.q: Is there a Q&A after the pitch?
faqs.a: No. The summit pitch is a 10-minute presentation with no Q&A session.
faqs.alt: There is no Q&A at the summit. Each of the 4 finalist teams has a 10-minute presentation slot.

faqs.kw: partner partners ocm cmap collaborator host uitm hackdev cmp associate organizational communication management
faqs.a: Our partners are Organizational Communication Management (OCM), CMP Associate and UiTM Shah Alam, which also hosts the event. HackDev is our collaborator and provides 5 mentors.
faqs.alt: OCM, CMP Associate and UiTM Shah Alam are our partners, and HackDev is our mentoring collaborator.

faqs.kw: hackdev hack dev hackdev.my partner collaborate collaboration community cybersecurity
faqs.a: We collaborate with HackDev Malaysia, a student-led community with 2,000+ members across Malaysia that runs hands-on workshops, CTFs, mentorship and open-source projects. Learn more at hackdev.my.
faqs.alt: HackDev Malaysia is a student-led community with more than 2,000 members. They run workshops, CTFs and mentorship, and they collaborate with UNLOCK. See hackdev.my.

faqs.q: Will there be mentors to guide us?
faqs.kw: mentor mentors guide guidance coach help support hackdev 5 lima
faqs.a: Yes. Through our collaborator HackDev, 5 mentors will guide the teams during the incubation.
faqs.alt: Yes, you will not be alone. Five mentors from our collaborator HackDev will guide the teams throughout the incubation.

faqs.a: Follow us on Instagram and TikTok at @unlockai.project. The links are in the Contacts section.
faqs.alt: We are on Instagram and TikTok as @unlockai.project, with direct links in the Contacts section.

faqs.q: What is the objective of UNLOCK?
faqs.a: To enhance knowledge and understanding of Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications in the workplace, encourage the development of innovative ideas and practical AI-driven solutions, and strengthen strategic collaboration among universities, industries, and communities towards ethical, responsible, and sustainable AI adoption.
faqs.alt: UNLOCK aims to build understanding of workplace AI, encourage innovative and practical AI-driven solutions, and strengthen collaboration between universities, industries and communities for ethical, responsible and sustainable AI adoption.

officialName: UNLOCK: The AI & Young Professionals Summit & Innovation Challenge

askOnly.q: What is UNLOCK?
askOnly.kw: unlock about event summit challenge apa
askOnly.a: UNLOCK is an AI workplace innovation challenge and grand expo hosted at UiTM Shah Alam. Ten teams build AI prototypes in a 3-week online sprint, and the Top 2 teams from each category showcase and pitch them at the Grand Finale on 6 December 2026 at Dewan Seroja, UiTM Shah Alam.
askOnly.alt: It is the AI & Young Professionals Summit & Innovation Challenge: a 3-week online incubation for 10 teams, followed by a physical Grand Finale at Dewan Seroja, UiTM Shah Alam, where the 4 finalist teams exhibit and pitch their AI prototypes.

askOnly.q: Who organises UNLOCK?
askOnly.kw: organiser organizer committee penganjur
askOnly.a: UNLOCK is run by the UNLOCK committee, with OCM, CMP Associate and UiTM Shah Alam (the host) as partners and HackDev as collaborator.
askOnly.alt: The UNLOCK committee organises it, with OCM, CMP Associate and UiTM Shah Alam as partners and HackDev as collaborator.

askOnly.q: When does registration close?
askOnly.kw: deadline closing last date tutup closes
askOnly.a: Registration closes on Wednesday 11 November 2026, or earlier if all 5 team places in a category are filled.
askOnly.alt: You have until 11 November 2026, but each category has only 5 team places, so the form closes as soon as they are taken. Check the live team spots on this page.

askOnly.q: Is the event online or physical?
askOnly.kw: online physical hybrid venue location held
askOnly.a: Both. The 3-week workshop sprint is online on Google Meet, and the Grand Finale on 6 December 2026 is in person at Dewan Seroja, UiTM Shah Alam.
askOnly.alt: The workshops are online on Sunday 15, Saturday 21 and Saturday 28 November. The Grand Finale is physical at Dewan Seroja, UiTM Shah Alam.

askOnly.q: How much is the registration fee?
askOnly.kw: fee yuran cost price free percuma bayar payment pay
askOnly.a: The registration fee is RM65 per team for the Student category and RM180 per team for the Young Professional category. For now it is a pre-registration, so you pay later: we email the payment details after you pre-register.
askOnly.alt: It is RM65 per team for students and RM180 per team for young professionals. You do not pay at pre-registration; we email the payment details afterwards.

askOnly.q: Do I need AI or coding experience?
askOnly.kw: experience beginner coding skill programming pengalaman knowledge
askOnly.a: Week 1 teaches Applied AI Literacy in the Workplace and modern AI prototyping tools, and Week 2 guides you through wireframing and system design, so the workshops help you build your prototype. If you are unsure about your team's skills, ask us.
askOnly.alt: The sprint is guided: AI literacy and prototyping tools in Week 1, architecture and wireframing in Week 2, and prototype testing in Week 3. For specific concerns about skills, contact the committee.

askOnly.q: What will we build?
askOnly.kw: build project prototype create product idea innovation
askOnly.a: A working AI prototype or proof of concept that solves a realistic workplace problem in your chosen track, with clear user workflows and measurable business impact.
askOnly.alt: Each team designs and builds an AI-powered solution for a real organisational challenge, showing the problem, the AI architecture, the user flows and the expected impact.

askOnly.q: Can students and professionals be in the same team?
askOnly.kw: mixed same team combine both category
askOnly.a: Each team registers under one category: Student for university students, or Young Professional for early-career working adults. If your team is mixed, please ask the committee before registering.
askOnly.alt: Teams are registered as either Student or Young Professional. For a mixed team, contact us so we can advise you.

askOnly.q: What if my team has fewer than 5 members?
askOnly.kw: fewer less four members incomplete exactly short
askOnly.a: Every team must have exactly 5 members. If you are still looking for members, ask the committee how we can help.
askOnly.alt: The rule is strictly 5 members per team, so please complete your team before registering. Contact us if you need advice.

askOnly.q: How are the finalists chosen?
askOnly.kw: finalist finalists selection select top 2 top 4 how many evaluate chosen
askOnly.a: In Workshop 3 on 28 November, industry panels evaluate all 10 prototypes. The Top 2 Student and Top 2 Young Professional teams are chosen to set up booths and pitch live at the Grand Finale.
askOnly.alt: After the Workshop 3 evaluation, the judges score every team with the rubric, and the top 2 from each category go to the Grand Finale.

askOnly.q: Do all teams join the summit?
askOnly.kw: all teams attend booth exhibit finale everyone
askOnly.a: No. Only the Top 2 Student teams and the Top 2 Young Professional teams (4 finalists) advance to the Grand Finale, where they set up interactive booths in Zone B and pitch on the Main Stage.
askOnly.alt: Only the 4 finalists join the summit. They exhibit at booths and present on stage.

askOnly.q: What do we need to prepare for the summit?
askOnly.kw: bring prepare booth setup what to bring
askOnly.a: Only the 4 finalist teams take part in the summit. They prepare a working prototype, an interactive booth setup for Zone B, the AI-Use Declaration and a 10-minute pitch. Booth setup times and the stage schedule will be sent by email and WhatsApp.
askOnly.alt: If you are one of the 4 finalists, prepare your prototype, your booth exhibition setup, the AI-Use Declaration and your 10-minute pitch. We will email the schedule.

askOnly.q: How long is the pitch?
askOnly.kw: pitch presentation minutes duration time slot
askOnly.a: Each of the 4 finalist teams has a 10-minute presentation with no Q&A.
askOnly.alt: Finalists get 10 minutes on the Main Stage, and there is no Q&A session after it.

askOnly.q: Will the workshops be recorded?
askOnly.kw: recording record youtube replay miss class rakaman
askOnly.a: Yes. Class recordings are unlisted on YouTube, and the link is sent in the WhatsApp community and by email.
askOnly.alt: Recordings are shared as unlisted YouTube links through the WhatsApp community and email, so you can catch up if you miss a class.

askOnly.q: Where are the workshops held?
askOnly.kw: workshop class link zoom online where how join
askOnly.a: The workshops are online on Google Meet. The link is emailed 2 days before and on the day of each workshop, and shared in the WhatsApp community.
askOnly.alt: Classes run online on Sunday 15, Saturday 21 and Saturday 28 November. You will receive the Google Meet link by email 2 days before and on the day of each class.

askOnly.q: Do I have to attend every class?
askOnly.kw: attendance absent compulsory miss required hadir attendance form
askOnly.a: Yes, teams are expected at all three workshops. Unapproved absence from required checkpoints can lead to disqualification, so please inform the committee in advance if you cannot attend.
askOnly.alt: Please attend all three online sessions (15, 21 and 28 November). Missing a required checkpoint without approval risks disqualification, so tell us early.

askOnly.q: Can we use ChatGPT or other AI tools?
askOnly.kw: chatgpt gemini claude copilot ai tools allowed llm api
askOnly.a: Yes, third-party AI models, APIs and frameworks are allowed, but you must disclose all of them in the official AI-Use Declaration. Plagiarism and fabricated data are not allowed.
askOnly.alt: AI tools are part of the challenge. Just declare every tool and how you used it in the AI-Use Declaration.

askOnly.q: Will there be certificates?
askOnly.kw: certificate sijil medal medals participant
askOnly.a: All 50 participants receive a medal for completing the incubation. For certificate details, please contact the committee.
askOnly.alt: Every participant receives a medal. If you need information on certificates, email us.

askOnly.q: Who are the judges and mentors?
askOnly.kw: judge panel mentor instructor speaker juri
askOnly.a: Industry panels evaluate the prototypes. The teams are guided by 5 mentors from our collaborator HackDev. For the names of judges, mentors and speakers, please follow our social media or contact the committee.
askOnly.alt: The prototypes are judged by industry panels, and 5 mentors from HackDev guide the teams. Announcements about speakers and mentors are shared through our official channels.

askOnly.q: How can I contact the committee?
askOnly.kw: contact reach email hubungi help support
askOnly.a: You can email us from the Contacts section, or message @unlockai.project on Instagram and TikTok.
askOnly.alt: Use the Contacts section on this page for our email, or follow @unlockai.project on Instagram and TikTok.

askOnly.q: How do I know my team is registered?
askOnly.kw: confirm registered confirmation email registration id check status
askOnly.a: The team leader and every member whose email you entered receive a confirmation email with your Registration ID. The live team spots on this page also update.
askOnly.alt: After you submit the form, check your inbox (and spam folder) for the confirmation email with your Registration ID.

askOnly.q: I did not receive the confirmation email
askOnly.kw: no email not received spam missing didn't got
askOnly.a: Please check your spam or promotions folder and wait a few minutes. If it still has not arrived, email us with your team name and the email you used.
askOnly.alt: Confirmation emails go to the team leader and every member email on the form. If yours is missing, contact us with your team name so we can check.

askOnly.q: Can I change my team members after registering?
askOnly.kw: change replace edit update withdraw cancel member swap tukar
askOnly.a: Please contact the committee as soon as possible so we can check what can be changed. An email is the fastest way.
askOnly.alt: Changes to a registered team need the committee's approval. Contact us with your team name and the change you need.

askOnly.q: Who is on the UNLOCK team?
askOnly.kw: team committee president vice president advisor bureau organiser pasukan ahli jawatankuasa how many committee members
askOnly.a: The committee is led by President Syed Aiman Hafique and Vice President Syaza Athirah, advised by Dr. Ahlam Abdul Aziz and Dr. Nurul Atiqah binti Mohd Azlan. Five bureaus run the event: Programme, Protocol, Multimedia & Publicity, Sponsorship, and Logistic & Technical. Meet everyone on the Our Team page.
askOnly.alt: UNLOCK is run by 35 committee members across five bureaus, guided by two advisors. You can see all of them on the Our Team page.

askOnly.q: Who are the advisors?
askOnly.kw: advisor adviser lecturer penasihat doctor dr
askOnly.a: Our two advisors are Dr. Ahlam Abdul Aziz and Dr. Nurul Atiqah binti Mohd Azlan.
askOnly.alt: UNLOCK is advised by Dr. Ahlam Abdul Aziz and Dr. Nurul Atiqah binti Mohd Azlan. See them on the Our Team page.

askOnly.q: Who is the president of UNLOCK?
askOnly.kw: president vice presiden pengerusi leader head
askOnly.a: The President is Syed Aiman Hafique and the Vice President is Syaza Athirah.
askOnly.alt: UNLOCK is led by President Syed Aiman Hafique, supported by Vice President Syaza Athirah.

askOnly.q: How many committee members are there?
askOnly.kw: committee jawatankuasa organisers organizers how many advisors bureaus
askOnly.a: UNLOCK has 35 committee members across 5 bureaus, guided by 2 advisors. Meet everyone on the Our Team page.
askOnly.alt: There are 35 committee members in 5 bureaus, plus 2 advisors. You can see all of them on the Our Team page.
